svg.title: APOGEE — conceptual model rocket and planned instrumentation
svg.desc: An editable engineering illustration of a planned model rocket. The external elevation identifies its nose cone, airframe, fins, conceptual avionics bay and external commercial-motor interface. A separate planned data-flow diagram connects sensor acquisition, firmware and logging, ground replay, and offline analysis. Concept only, not to scale. No propulsion internals, dimensions, built hardware or flight performance are depicted.
